description: Correct a visit the rep logged: move it to the right day, replace or take off its note, or set how it went. Pick the visit by its id (visits[].id on the record, from log_visit or changes_since) or by the surgeon's NPI and the day it is logged on; several on one day come back with their ids to ask which. Only the rep who logged a visit can change it; what it was (a call, a meeting) stays. A connected HubSpot's copy is corrected too. Use when the rep says a logged visit was wrong, after reading back the correction.

move_to.description: The right day, YYYY-MM-DD. Not in the future.

note.description: The new note, without any patient information; it replaces the old one, and an empty string takes the note off.

npi.description: 10-digit NPI; use search to find it.

on.description: With npi instead of an id: the day the visit is logged on now, YYYY-MM-DD.

outcome.description: How it went; none takes the outcome off.

visit.description: The visit's id, from the record's visits.

name: edit_visit
title: Correct a visit
